SHAPE ONLY -- this file carries no measurement. A gate's time budget is a DECLARED MULTIPLE of a MEASURED runtime, never a round number: budget_sec = margin_x x measured_sec. A cap picked by feel is uncalibrated in both directions -- too low, it kills a healthy gate and reports a timeout as a verdict; too high, it hides a hung one. So each gate's cap is derived, with the margin, the measured runtime and the ABSOLUTE revision the measurement was taken at declared together, so the number carries its own basis and a reader can recompute it. The budget VALUES belong to the process owner, never to the implementing lane.

Copy this file to registry/gates.json and replace every value with a measurement of YOUR box: measured_sec from your own audit run, measured_at the absolute revision that run describes, margin_x a stated multiple of that measurement. A gate with no entry uses default.budget_sec, and the runner PRINTS which gates used it -- a declared default with a printed population is not an exempt-by-silence surface. A budget exhausted is UNKNOWN: never green, never a plain failure, and its recorded duration is the MEASURED elapsed time, never a hardcoded zero.

THE INVOCATION MODE (#195). `modes` declares, per gate, WHICH convention your audit invokes it by -- `script` (the file is run directly, its `__main__` block owns the verdict) or `pytest` (it is collected, the test functions own it). The split is INTENDED and is not converted: a gate's form is a property of what it tests, not a uniform. What matters to you is that a CI running only `pytest` enforces only the pytest-invoked population -- so a green CI is NOT evidence that every gate passed, and this map is how you compute which ones it reached. The mode is declared at the CALL SITE's form, never the file's shape, because a dual-shaped file answers a different question. You do not have to transcribe this map by hand: `python3 tests/test_gate_invocation_mode.py --emit-modes` prints the map your own `tools/audit.py` implies, and the same gate asserts the declaration against it.

THE LOAD THE MEASUREMENT WAS TAKEN AT (#226). An optional `load_at_measure` beside `measured_sec` records the box load when that runtime was measured. It is OPTIONAL and its absence is PRINTED, never refused: a cap exceeded at load 13 and the same cap exceeded on an idle box are the same number and DIFFERENT facts, so a reader meeting a kill can tell a busy box from a hung gate only where the base states the load it was measured at. A NEW or UPDATED measurement should carry it; the audit lists the entries that do not, so the gap is readable rather than silent.

THE EXIT DECLARATION (#295). Every gate a factory registers declares the class of the lawful path from a red on an ALREADY-EXISTING violation back to green. This file ships the SHAPE, with one example entry per class, because the classes are the kit's and the declarations are the factory's: which gate is which is a property of what that gate reads, and the kit carries no such gate. The vocabulary is CLOSED -- `write-path-refusal` (`refuser`), `exemption-table` (`table`, optionally `refuser`), `repair-verb` (`command`), `always-satisfiable` (no fields: the subject is an artifact in this tree), and `exit-owed` (`board`) -- and a class outside it is an ERROR rather than a new word, because a vocabulary that grows one ad-hoc token at a time is the silent-absence defect one level up. The registering lane REFUSES a gate that carries no declaration; resolves each declared table and refuser against this tree, with an exemption table's `.example.json` skeleton counting as a surface so a table that legitimately holds zero entries is expressible; and reports a STALE declaration (a key no longer invoked, a declared table the gate's own source never names, or a factory exemption table no declaration names). `exit-owed` is the honest class for a gate with no exit at all: it PRINTS as filed debt rather than being forced into a false exit. The CLASS is a declaration by the registering lane and not a proof -- nothing mechanical can decide whether a repair verb reaches a given predicate -- so what this removes is the silent ABSENCE, which is the shape that made the gap findable only one gate at a time.
